free_tier.stated: a one-time trial: eligible new accounts get $10 to try after a $1 card check and refund, up to 7 days, on any GPU size on one machine; files are kept for 24 hours after the trial ends. Paid use is prepaid credit added from $10, billed by the minute: machines from $1.40 an hour for an L4 (24 GB) and $2.64 for an L40S (48 GB), up to $7.41 for a 96 GB RTX PRO 6000 with 256 GB of RAM. The page lists no H100, A100 or RTX 4090.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the unit is a machine-hour, not an object

retention.stated: files are kept for 24 hours after the trial ends; a paused machine keeps its disk as a snapshot, billed at $2.70 a month in the page's example, and deleting the machine ends that charge

egress.terms: traffic out is $0.10 per GB; disks are $0.15 per GB-month written and shared files $0.10 per GB-month

interface_detail: the home page says to work over SSH, in VS Code or with an AI assistant, and an app catalog installs ComfyUI, PyTorch, JupyterLab, Ollama and vLLM in one click. No public API is documented on the page read.
tooling: a cloud Linux workspace (a slice of an L4 at $0.24 an hour) plus attached whole-card machines of 24, 48 or 96 GB VRAM; SSH, VS Code, a desktop and Android app, and one-click ComfyUI, vLLM and Ollama installs. Machines pause themselves after 15 minutes idle.
chaining: the trial is one machine for up to 7 days, so it fits a single short render or fine-tune run, not a standing service; the paused-machine disk is billed per month.

limits.value: the trial is $10 of credit on one machine for up to 7 days, about 4 hours 52 minutes on the smallest L4 before storage, traffic and the stop margin, subject to a daily trial allowance

limits_note: the trial credit is the binding number; workspace and machines pause after 15 minutes with no input, no GPU work, no traffic and no running process
binding_note: the $10 trial credit, 7-day window and one machine bound the free route; paid use is prepaid per minute with no stated cap

identity_cost.detail: the trial needs a $1 card check that is refunded: 'Eligible new accounts get $10 to try after a $1 card check and refund.' Paid credit is prepaid from $10; the payment methods for it, and any phone or ID check, are not stated on the page read.

reliability_note: unverified: no status page or incident history was read; the page lists limited regional availability (US and EU) as a drawback
confidence_note: the rates and the trial terms are read on the vendor's own home page on 2026-11-03
